padInterval: Membership dues on each billing date, and other charges you approve
importCardsHelp: Import cards attached to this household’s Stripe customer outside the app. An existing default stays selected. With no default, the newest card whose stored expiry has not passed is selected; if every card has expired, the newest is selected. Removed cards stay removed.
importCardsQueued: Card import queued. It runs in the background. Refresh payment methods to see new cards. If none appear, ask an owner or admin to check the import's audit trail and failed jobs on the health page.
errors.card_import_no_customer: This household has no linked Stripe customer. Link its customer before importing cards.
errors.card_import_refused: These cards could not be imported because the Stripe customer belongs to another gym or household, or was deleted. Ask an owner or admin to check the customer in Stripe.
errors.card_import_changed: The household’s Stripe customer or payment configuration changed. Refresh the page and request the import again.
title: Invoices
householdSearchHelp: Showing up to 25 matches. Search by household name to narrow the list.
noChargeTypesManager: No charge types are set up. Add one in the billing catalog, or use a custom amount.
noChargeTypesCatalog: No charge types are set up. Add one in the billing catalog.
noChargeTypesCustom: No charge types are set up. Ask an owner or admin to add one, or use a custom amount.
noChargeTypes: No charge types are set up. Ask an owner or admin to add one.
createHelp: This creates a separate invoice. Then choose a saved payment method, cash or check, or a pay link.
saveError: Could not save. Reload the invoice and check for a pending payment before trying again.
cannotBeDefault: This bank account can't be used for automatic charges at this gym, so it can't be the default.
defaultCannotCharge: This bank account can't be used for automatic charges at this gym. Make another payment method the default.
refundHelp: The refund goes back to the original card. Pending refunds reserve the amount. A reservation that never reached Stripe clears automatically after 23 hours, within the next hourly check. If still pending after 24 hours, ask an owner or admin to check Stripe and payment reconciliation.
manualRefundHelp: Return the cash or check to the payer before confirming this manual refund.
chargeHelp: Confirm this charge to the household’s default saved payment method.
removeHelp: Remove this payment method from the household and detach it at Stripe.
removeDefaultHelp: The newest remaining payment method without an expiry date or whose stored expiry has not passed becomes the default for automatic payments. If every remaining method has expired, the newest becomes the default. If no payment methods remain, automatic payments stop until another is saved.
defaultHelp: Use this payment method for automatic payments.
showLink: Show a link to copy or open
linkSent: Pay link sent to the household.
manualNoticeSent: Manual-payment instructions sent to the household.
chargeFailed: The charge failed. The invoice stays open; choose another payment method.
requiresAction: The card needs the payer’s authentication. Send a pay link.
pendingCharge: The payment is still being resolved. A card payment usually settles within minutes; a bank debit can take a few business days.
releaseHoldHelp: Confirm collection of this overdue invoice. The next billing run will charge the saved payment method unless you charge it now or record a payment first.
holdReleased: Review hold released. The next billing run will charge the saved payment method unless you charge it now or record a payment first.
releaseHoldHelpNoCard: Confirm collection of this overdue invoice. This household has no active default payment method, so the billing run won’t charge it. Send a pay link or record a payment.
holdReleasedNoCard: Review hold released. This household has no active default payment method, so the billing run won’t charge it. Send a pay link or record a payment.
releaseProcessing: Stop waiting for this bank debit
releaseProcessingHelp: Use this when the dashboard counts this invoice under bank debits to check. Stripe is checked first: the invoice can be collected again only if Stripe reports the debit failed or cancelled, so no money can arrive.
processingReleased: The invoice no longer waits for the bank debit. Collect it, send a pay link or void it.
errors.billing_disabled: Billing is disabled. Enable billing before charging a saved payment method.
errors.not_payable: This invoice is no longer available for collection. Reload it to see its status.
errors.needs_review: An owner or admin must release the review hold before charging a saved payment method.
errors.pending_attempt: The payment is still being resolved. A card payment usually settles within minutes; a bank debit can take a few business days.
errors.no_saved_card: Add an active default payment method for this household before charging.
errors.already_attempted: Automatic collection has already been attempted for this invoice.
errors.outside_retry_window: This invoice is outside the scheduled retry window.
errors.not_auto_collectable: This invoice requires a staff payment action.
errors.not_due: This invoice is not due yet.
errors.checkout_changed: The pay link changed during collection. Reload the invoice before trying again.
errors.reservation_lost: The charge reservation changed. Check back shortly.
errors.action_required: The existing card payment needs the payer’s authentication.
errors.below_minimum: This invoice is below the smallest card charge Stripe takes in its currency. Record a cash or check payment instead.
errors.off_step: This invoice amount is finer than a card charge in its currency allows. Record a cash or check payment instead.
errors.collection_changed: The invoice, customer or saved payment method changed before confirmation. Reload the invoice.
errors.void_links_changed: Payment links changed while this invoice was being voided. Reload the invoice and try again.
errors.zero_invoice: No payment is needed for this invoice.
errors.open_dispute: Resolve the open payment dispute before collecting this invoice.
errors.already_paid: This invoice is already paid. Do not take another payment.
errors.payment_mismatch: The payment amount or currency changed. Reload the invoice.
errors.runner_unavailable: Card collection is not configured. Contact an owner or admin.
errors.payments_unavailable: Stripe is unavailable. Any existing card or pay-link payment must be resolved before collecting again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to perform this action.
errors.card_removed: This payment method has been removed. Choose another active payment method.
errors.payment_method_currency: This bank account can't be charged in this gym's currency. Choose a card or another account.
errors.payment_method_mandate: This pre-authorized debit has no mandate on file, so it can't be the default. Choose another payment method.
errors.detach_unavailable: Payment method removal is not configured. Contact an owner or admin.
errors.refund_mismatch: The refund amount or currency does not match the payment.
errors.refund_off_step: Stripe refunds this currency to the card only in whole steps: whole ISK or UGX, or a last decimal of 0 in a three-decimal currency such as KWD. Enter a rounded amount.
errors.invalid_amount: Enter a valid amount, with no more decimal places than the currency uses.
errors.pending_refund: This payment has a pending refund. Resolve it before requesting another: a retry must use its amount and reason, and a refund made in Stripe must finish first.
errors.refund_in_progress: A refund request for this payment is still being sent to Stripe. Try again in a minute.
errors.refund_reconciliation: The pending refund needs reconciliation before it can be retried.
errors.refund_reconciled: The pending refund was checked against Stripe and cleared, and this request moved no money. Check the payment, and refund again only if it is still owed.
errors.refund_released: The pending refund was released, so nothing was sent to Stripe. Check the payment, and refund again only if it is still owed.
errors.refund_identity: The processor refund could not be matched. Contact an owner or admin.
errors.test_payment: This is a Stripe test-mode payment, made before the gym switched to live, so it can’t be refunded. No real money moved.
errors.no_receipt: This invoice does not have a receipt yet.
errors.receipt_unavailable: Receipt delivery is not configured. Contact an owner or admin.
errors.charge_type_inactive: This charge type is inactive. Choose an active charge type.
errors.currency_mismatch: The invoice currency must match the gym’s billing currency.
errors.tax_rate_inactive: A selected tax rate is inactive. Reload and choose active tax rates.
errors.save_failed: Could not save. Reload the invoice and check for a pending payment before trying again.
needsReview: This invoice needs staff review before another charge.
emptyHelp: Change the status filter or add a one-off charge.
denied: You do not have access to invoices
householdInvoices: Invoices belong to the household and may include other household members.
sendUncertain: The earlier message may have been delivered, but we could not confirm it. Choose Send again only if you want another message.
errors.sms_payer_only: Billing links can only be texted to the payer. Use the billing phone or a consenting member at the billing email when no billing phone is selected.
smsRecipientsError: Text recipients could not be loaded.
smsHelp: Pay links go to the consenting billing phone, or otherwise a consenting member at the billing email. Recipients need a valid phone. Unavailable recipients are disabled in the delivery list.
errors.sms_no_consent: The recipient must consent to notices before a link can be texted.
errors.sms_invalid_phone: The recipient needs a valid phone before a link can be texted.
errors.household_email_missing: The household has no valid email address. Add one on the household, or show or text the link instead.
errors.email_disabled: Member email is turned off for this gym, so the link wasn't emailed. Turn it on in Settings, or show or text the link instead.
errors.recipient_suppressed: This email address is suppressed, so the link wasn't emailed.
errors.recipient_suppressed_sms: This number has opted out of texts, so the link wasn't texted.
errors.delivery_unavailable: Delivery isn't set up for this channel, so the link wasn't sent.
errors.delivery_failed: The link couldn't be delivered. Try again, or show the link instead.
voidHelp: This invoice will no longer be owed. Dunning and retries stop, and its pay links are revoked. This does not cancel a membership or change future invoices. Give a reason for the audit record.
invoiceVoided: Invoice voided. No payment is owed on this invoice.
errors.checkout_reserved: A Checkout payment is reserved for this invoice. Resolve it before voiding the invoice.
errors.not_processing: This invoice is no longer waiting for a bank debit. Reload it to see its status.
errors.debit_not_stuck: This bank debit hasn't been flagged for checking. Bank debits can take several days; the dashboard counts it if it needs you.
errors.debit_paid: Stripe reports this debit as paid, so the invoice keeps waiting for it. Check the payment in the Stripe Dashboard.
errors.debit_processing: Stripe reports this debit as still processing. Wait for it to settle.
errors.debit_open: Stripe still shows this debit as open. Cancel the payment in the Stripe Dashboard, then try again.
errors.debit_mismatch: Stripe's record of this debit doesn't match this invoice. Check it in the Stripe Dashboard.
